text:
akshay: Quick qprofile pass for orion-13b bring-up. Ran FP16/BF16/INT8/FP8 across H100 (us-east1 / asia-east1) and A100 (eu-west1). Small-batch configs (batch=1 & batch=4). P50/P95 throughput + accuracy deltas on our dev eval set below.

maria: Nice. Which kernel variants did you use for INT8 on A100? fallback/simd?

akshay: For A100 INT8 used kernel v2 (simd-packed) + BSD caching. H100 INT8 used v3 (tensorcore-quant). For FP8 we used dynamic-exponent path on H100.

josh: Raw CSV (columns: region,gpu,prec,batch,p50_throughput,tokens/s,p95_latency_ms,acc_delta_pts):
```
us-east1,H100,FP16,1,18.9,120.3,46.2,0.0
us-east1,H100,FP8,1,25.4,161.7,52.1,-0.2
us-east1,H100,INT8,1,28.7,183.4,60.3,-0.5
eu-west1,A100,FP16,1,12.1,77.3,82.9,0.0
eu-west1,A100,INT8,1,15.8,101.0,95.0,-1.4
asia-east1,H100,FP16,1,17.2,109.0,50.8,0.0
asia-east1,H100,INT8,1,26.9,170.6,58.4,-0.6
```

bench-bot: run id 2024-06-12_akshay_qprofile complete — dashboard: https://redwood.internal/bench/20240612/qprofile/1719004321 :thumbsup:

maria: Looks like INT8 on A100 in eu is giving ~ -1.4 pt regression on our dev set; maybe kernel quantization scale mismatch. Can we run int8-calib with per-channel scales?

akshay: Yep. Plan: 1) redo per-channel calib for A100 INT8 2) test fallback to FP16 for p95-critical routes 3) re-run overnight with batch=4 to get throughput scaling numbers.

sre-ops: For capacity planning: p95 latency hill in eu-west1 for A100 INT8 is ~95ms which affects our target of 80ms. If fallback to FP16 for spike %>10 we'll need +30% GPU pool for EU to keep SLOs.

josh: I'll queue a focused run: per-channel calib + kernel-v2-tune. Will post results tomorrow morning.

maria: Also add quality checks: fail if acc_delta < -1.0 for any customer-dev prompt set. Add flag run:'block-rollout' if triggered.

akshay: agreed. Thanks — will follow up with the tuned numbers.
